metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Blue Box
metas.description: Third-year student Taiki joins badminton club. Despite being an early riser, star player Chinatsu, his crush, arrives first. Living together unexpectedly, Taiki strives to reach Nationals to impress Chinatsu.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Witch Hat Atelier
metas.description: The series follows a girl named Coco, who dreams of being a witch, but in her world only those born with magical abilities are able to become witches. However, after meeting a witch named Qifrey, Coco's dream begins to come true.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2024 · Orb: On the Movements of the Earth
metas.description: After learning heretical teachings about the Earth and the Sun, a child prodigy searches for his master's hidden research while evading the Inquisition.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2025 · Kurukshetra
metas.description: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
metas.description: In Elmore, reality bends and family life gets weird. Gumball pulls Darwin, Anais, and the whole town into adventures - from fighting evil fast food to dealing with an AI crushing on his mom. The show's so wild, it needed a new name.
